# CommitKind

`Flare.Components.Combobox.CommitKind`

The outcome of a commit intent, so the shell can forward the right consumer callback.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NoOp` | `0` | Nothing happened (no highlighted item, empty commit). |
| `Changed` | `1` | The selection set changed (added or removed); the shell should raise its value callback. |
| `RejectedMax` | `2` | Rejected: the maximum selection count was already reached. |
| `RejectedDisabled` | `3` | Rejected: the target option is disabled. |
| `RejectedEmpty` | `4` | Rejected: removing would empty a selection that must keep at least one item. |
